title: Reporting a death to Social Security
facts: Funeral homes generally report a death to Social Security when they have the deceased person's Social Security number and the family authorizes the report.
If the death has not been reported, survivors can contact Social Security to report it and discuss possible benefits.

Social Security benefits paid for the month of death or later can require return depending on the benefit and payment timing; survivors should not assume a payment deposited after death belongs to the estate.
Banks and SSA have procedures for reclaiming certain post-death electronic benefit payments.
